The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- **Dormant unmatched contributors** are skipped and no longer appear in "Undefined Team".
- **Blank latest-commit dates** count as active. `Contributor.isActive()` delegates to `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which returns true for blank dates, so no existing code had to change.
- **Configured teams** are handled earlier in the loop and are untouched, so they keep all members, active or not.

The codeanalyzer module compiles and its test suite ran offline with no failures reported. There are no existing tests for this landscape logic, and I did not add one or check the behaviour against real landscape data. Nothing is committed.
